text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- An association of suppliers of medicines and medical equipment said the government owed its members two million Maltese pounds. Some payments had been overdue for years and were causing cash flow problems. Road building contractors made similar complaints last week.
- Italian holidaymaker Giancarlo Badi of Tuscany drowned off Sliema, Malta's most important tourist centre.
- Malta is experiencing temperatures of around 36 degrees Centigrade (97 Fahrenheit), normal for this time of year, but humidity is far higher than normal, making conditions difficult.
